name: Bling-Bang-Bang-Born
blurb: Creepy Nuts' 2024 Mashle opening theme and the BBBB dance copied from its credits
title: Bling-Bang-Bang-Born by Creepy Nuts: Why the BBBB Dance Went Viral
description: Bling-Bang-Bang-Born is Creepy Nuts' opening theme for Mashle season 2, released January 2024; the BBBB dance from its credits made it a global TikTok hit.
answer: "Bling-Bang-Bang-Born" is a song by the Japanese hip-hop duo Creepy Nuts, written as the opening theme for season 2 of the anime Mashle: Magic and Muscles and released on 7 January 2024. It went viral through the "BBBB dance": fans on TikTok and YouTube copied the deadpan hand-and-arm routine that the hero, Mash, performs in the opening credits. It spent 19 weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard Japan Hot 100 and peaked at No. 8 on the Billboard Global 200.

body: In the anime's opening sequence, Mash Burnedead, a muscle-bound boy born without magic in a world run by it, dances to the song with a blank face. The routine is fast but done mostly in place: quick, precise hand and arm moves timed to the beat, with the expression never changing. That made it easy to film in a bedroom and funny to drop into other characters' bodies.

body.note: Creepy Nuts are rapper R-Shitei and DJ Matsunaga. They have said they never expected to see Mash dancing in the opening, or for people to react the way they did.

head: Date
Event
rows: Creepy Nuts are announced as the performers of the Mashle season 2 opening.
The opening song is posted on the anime's official YouTube channel; the full version comes out on streaming the next day.
The BBBB dance challenge spreads on TikTok and YouTube; a fan animation of Jax from The Amazing Digital Circus doing the dance passes 14 million views in three weeks.
An official music video made with Mashle is released (3 March), followed by a double A-side CD with "Nidone" (20 March).
Japan's RIAJ certifies the song Diamond for streaming, meaning more than 500 million streams.

body: The title works more as a chant than a sentence: "bling" and "bang" are sound words that match the song's bouncy Jersey club beat. "Born" is usually read as a nod to Mash, who was born without magic and gets by on muscle instead. The lyrics are in Japanese with the English title words as the hook.

ul: Billboard Japan Hot 100: No. 1 for 19 non-consecutive weeks, second only to YOASOBI's "Idol" (22 weeks); Japan's best-performing song of 2024.
Certified Gold by the RIAA in the United States.
Song of the Year at both the 2025 MTV Video Music Awards Japan and the 2025 Music Awards Japan; a special award at TikTok's 2024 first-half Trend Awards in Japan.

faq.a: Creepy Nuts, the Japanese duo of rapper R-Shitei and DJ Matsunaga. R-Shitei wrote the lyrics and DJ Matsunaga produced the track.

faq.q: How do you do the BBBB dance?
faq.a: Stand in place, keep a completely straight face and copy Mash's quick hand and arm moves from the Mashle season 2 opening, hitting each move on the beat. Many people learn it from slowed-down tutorials and mirror videos.
It is the opening theme of Mashle: Magic and Muscles season 2, The Divine Visionary Candidate Exam, which began airing in January 2024.
